request: A recording admission run must hold the plan's write lock from the re-read it compares against through the write it performs, so a writer that cooperates cannot land an edit between the two.

defects.description: Own-history fix a9a52847b8 (2026-09-15): fix(admit,plan): a recording run takes the plan lock it was writing without

trigger.input:
printf %s  | base64 -d > internal/admit/admit_test.go
if go test -count=1 -run \^TestRecordWaitsForThePlanLock\$ ./internal/admit >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo probe: pass; else echo probe: fail; fi

defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
